title: Composition into a three-query system
statement: Let $n>0$, and let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions. Given a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$, the composed system has input length $n$, proof length $m+K s$ where $s$ is the number of seeds of $V$'s verifier, and exactly three query positions.
hypotheses_covered: A seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
